decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the Location Plan, Design and Access Statement and drawings 153 PRO-01-A and 153EX-01revA received on 26/01/2015  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes incidental to the occupation of the dwelling known as 45 Rosemary Avenue and shall not be occupied as separate or ancillary residential accommodation or for business use.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden for use as storage
